svg.title: HEX1000 Tang Nano 1K physical Dupont cable map

g.text: Tang Nano 1K: physical Dupont cable map
Component side facing you. USB connector UP. Match the board photo; do not count chip pins.
Colored labels identify cables. Gray connections stay unused. Package numbers are shown for software.
GND rail: strip GND + display + shifter
Keypad: rows are driven LOW one at a time; columns and operator inputs use pull-ups.
No extra power/GND lead on the 8-wire passive keypad. The operator strip GND goes to the GND rail.
MAX7219 signal cables: use its INPUT header (DIN), not the DOUT end.
FPGA 18 -> 74AHCT125 pin 5 (2A) -> pin 6 (2Y) -> display CS / LOAD
See wiring.md and the level-shifter diagram for power, enable pins, resistors and decoupling.
Board photo/pin order: Sipeed Nano 1K pinmap. Wiring proposal; firmware and hardware validation pending.
